title: Ampure Bead Clean Up for High Molecular Weight DNA
author: Natalie Solonenko
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6kphcvn
materials: Flick tube gently to mix beads and sample.

steps.title: Resuspend beads
steps.instruction: Vortex the Ampure beads vigorously until they are completely resuspended before use.

steps.title: Add beads to sample
steps.instruction: Add the ratio of resuspended beads specified in your main protocol (ratio depends on the DNA length you wish to recover).

steps.title: Incubate binding
steps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes, flicking gently periodically to keep beads from settling.

steps.title: Magnetic separation (first)
steps.instruction: Place tubes on a magnetic rack (any rack that fits your tubes, e.g., Thermo Scientific MR02). Wait 2 minutes for beads to collect on the magnetic side; the supernatant should become clear.

steps.title: First ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Wash the bead‑bound DNA with 80 % ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL 80 % ethanol to each sample, pipetting onto the opposite side of the tube without disturbing the beads; volume may be adjusted as long as beads are fully covered.
Incubate at room temperature for 30 seconds.
Remove the ethanol carefully, avoiding disturbance of the beads.

steps.title: Repeat ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the ethanol‑wash procedure described in the previous step (add ethanol, incubate 30 s, remove).

steps.title: Remove residual ethanol
steps.instruction: Spin the tubes briefly, place them back on the magnetic stand, and remove any residual ethanol.

steps.title: Dry beads
steps.instruction: With caps open, remove tubes from the magnet and air‑dry until the bead surface has a matte finish. If beads appear cracked (over‑drying), resuspend immediately; over‑dried beads do not resuspend well.

substeps.instruction: Add a minimum of 15 µL water or low‑EDTA TE (use the volume specified in your main protocol) and flick gently to mix.

steps.title: Magnetic separation (post‑elution)
steps.instruction: Place tubes back on the magnetic rack and wait 2 minutes for beads to separate; the solution should be clear.

steps.title: Collect eluate
steps.instruction: Pipette out the specified volume of eluate, taking care to avoid bead carry‑over.

substeps.instruction: If beads are observed in the pipetted eluate, return the eluate to the tube, wait another 2 minutes, and repeat the collection.
If necessary, reduce the removed volume by 1–2 µL.

steps.title: Discard supernatant
steps.instruction: Remove and discard the clear solution; DNA remains bound to the beads.
